ns2:section.sectionText: The strategic use of digital media for brand marketing, social communications, interactive video, mobile advertising, and other forms of Internet technology. A non-technical course that requires the completion of individual projects, collaborative discussions, experiential learning, and applications of course content and knowledge to personal activities. Use of Eluminate online platform with Compass. Weekly synchronic sessions with continuous shared information. Meets with INFO 490-S. Informatics students should register under INFO 490. No pre-requisites.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism or Media Studies or Media and Cinema Studies major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
